svg.title: To prove the bookkeeping, combine inherited physical, finite local and covariance-window letters into b(0) p . Its budget is T(x) = βF (x)s + X(x) + N(x), with −1/2 < s < b and X, N of rate −1/2. Thus T has rate s and eventually T ≤1, 2T ≤βb F . Evaluate uniform estimates on an empty-seed dummy sector at the same radius and cutoffand retain their background-independent weights. Its hypotheses hold and the estimates quantify over all real backgrounds; the weights are chosen before the integrated Gaussian value. Nonnegative weighted sales bounds imply b(0) ≤1 individually. The p inequality |eq −1| ≤2a for |q| ≤a ≤1 permits yp = 2b(0) p ; the arranged factor-two reserve pays its budget: multiplying the sales budget by two costs at most βb F . Forced letters retain their independent price. Real localization factors in [0, 1] can only decrease these bounds, proving (NF5) uniformly for logarithms and Mayer factors.
